    Common questions


    Who is a graphic designer and website developer in Kumasi?

    Yirenkyi Gabriel Agyei of GABX NETWORK, based in Ahodwo, Kumasi, designs flyers and brand graphics and builds responsive websites.

    How much does a logo, flyer or website cost?

    Logo from GHS 150, flyer from GHS 50, advert placement flyer GHS 60, graphic design GHS 80, ads concept GHS 100, services package GHS 50 to 270, full branding with website from GHS 800. Use the price calculator and order on WhatsApp.

    How long does a website take?

    Simple sites can be ready in days; larger ones take a few weeks.

    Are the websites mobile friendly?

    Yes. Every site is responsive and tested on phones.
